# MateArte Uruguay

> MateArte is a family business from Paysandu, Uruguay, focused on handcrafted mates, bombillas, leather materas, thermoses and personalized gifts.

MateArte presents its catalog in Spanish, English and Brazilian Portuguese. Product names such as mate, bombilla, imperial and camionero retain their cultural terminology. All prices currently displayed by the website use Uruguayan pesos (UYU).
